title: Future Juice Vanilla Peanut Butter Cupcake  Shortfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Future Juice’s Vanilla Peanut Butter Cupcake is an indulgent blend that layers warm, aromatic Vanilla with the rich, nutty depth of Peanut Butter, all wrapped in a soft, golden Cupcake base. The sweet, smooth Vanilla creates a comforting foundation, while roasted Peanut Butter adds a savoury contrast, delivering a satisfying depth of flavour. Hints of Cupcake tie it all together, offering a warm, baked note that lingers with every puff. Blended at 70% VG / 30% PG, this high-VG e-liquid is designed for sub-ohm vaping, producing dense clouds and full-bodied flavour. Ideal for high-powered vape kits and sub-ohm tanks, it provides a consistently smooth vape with a well-rounded flavour profile. As a 100ml shortfill, this nicotine-free e-liquid leaves room for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing you to customise your strength. Adding two 18mg nic shots creates 120ml of 3mg e-liquid, while nic salt shots offer a milder throat hit compared to freebase nicotine. Future Juice is a UK-based e-liquid manufacturer dedicated to crafting premium blends with bold, layered flavours. Their shortfill range combines classic dessert and fruit-inspired profiles, designed for vapers who enjoy rich, satisfying e-liquids.
